issues.description: Golden reference model has syntax errors that prevent compilation. The `timescale directive is placed inside the module definition, and there is a syntax error on line 3. This causes the evaluator to reject even a correct submission.
issues.evidence: Validation report shows: 'evaluation/mac_golden.v:1: error: timescale directive cannot be inside a module definition.; evaluation/mac_golden.v:3: syntax error'

issues.description: Testbench has a syntax error: 'Malformed conditional expression' at line 281. This prevents compilation and makes the evaluator unusable.
issues.evidence: Validation report shows: 'evaluation/tb_mac_top.v:281: error: Malformed conditional expression.'

issues.description: Evaluator rejects the expert golden solution (golden_rejected failure class). The evaluator is buggy and cannot correctly grade a valid submission.
issues.evidence: Validation report differential shows golden_run expected 'pass' but got 'fail' with exit code 1.

issues.description: Testbench file appears truncated. The continuous golden comparison always block is incomplete, ending mid-expression with 'if ('.
issues.evidence: File content ends with: 'if (' without closing the conditional or the always block.

issues.description: The obfuscated netlist contains behavioral constructs (always blocks in DFF module, assign in MUX2 and full_adder) which contradicts the claim that it is purely structural with no behavioral constructs.
issues.evidence: DFF module uses 'always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)'; MUX2 uses 'assign Y = S ? B : A'; full_adder uses 'assign' statements.

issues.description: The netlist file has a syntax error in the DFF instance comments: '(.D(acc_next[0]),  .Q(acc_out[0]),  .clk(clk), .rst_n(rst_n));' contains double commas and missing port connections.
issues.evidence: Line: 'DFF dff_acc_0  (.D(acc_next[0]),  .Q(acc_out[0]),  .clk(clk), .rst_n(rst_n));' has malformed port list.

recommendations: Fix syntax errors in evaluation/mac_golden.v: move `timescale directive before the module definition, fix line 3 syntax error.
Fix syntax error in evaluation/tb_mac_top.v at line 281: complete the truncated always block and conditional expression.
Fix syntax errors in inputs/obfuscated_mac_netlist.v: correct the malformed DFF instance port connections (double commas, missing ports).
Ensure the obfuscated netlist is truly structural (no always blocks) or update the task description to accurately reflect its contents.
Re-run validation after fixes to confirm the evaluator accepts the golden solution and rejects the naive baseline.
